overview: An interactive theory lab that visualizes, simulates, and explains Laegna octave theory transcended one integral level up, including love as multiplicative combination, projection and metaphor mapping, and Fourier/Gaussian decomposition on the differential-linear-exponential space.
features: Explore how constant, linear, and exponential shift one integral level up
Simulate love as multiplicative combination between people
Decompose signals with Fourier components on the differential-linear-exponential space
Simplify complex non-symmetric curvatures into simple Gaussian frequencies
Map first-order math onto metaphor, poetic expression, and spiritual view
Write and save theory notebook entries tied to concepts and levels
Read guided essays linked to the Laegna, Spireason, and Tambet Väli sites
